items.q: How much does it cost to rent a PS5 in Warsaw?
items.a: A PS5 is 100 zł per day, a PS5 Pro is 110 zł, a PS4 Pro or Xbox is 80 zł. Longer is cheaper: from 3 days a PS5 costs 60 zł per day.
The console, 2 controllers, an account with games, plus discs. We deliver and connect it to your TV — all you need is Wi‑Fi.

items.q: Can I rent a PS5 with GTA VI?
items.a: Yes. GTA VI launches on 19 November 2026 and will be on our PS5s from day one. No need to buy the console or the game — book on Instagram in advance.
Yes, refundable: 300–400 zł for a console depending on the model and 300 zł for a hookah. You get it back when we pick up.

items.q: Can I rent a PS5 for a weekend or a week?
items.a: Yes. 2 days with a PS5 is 160 zł, from 3 days it's 60 zł per day. For 10+ days we'll give you a custom quote.

items.q: Where do you deliver and how fast?
items.a: Anywhere in Warsaw. We'll agree on the delivery time for your area in DM.
The hookah, 2 bowls already packed, 6 coals, a coal heater and 6 disposable mouthpieces. Ask about flavours in DM. Extra pack (one more bowl + 3 coals) — 30 zł.

items.q: Do I need to clean the hookah?
items.a: No. Just tell us when to pick it up. Mouthpieces are disposable and we wash the base after every order.

items.q: Can I order a hookah if I'm under 18?
items.a: No. Hookahs are for adults 18+ only. The courier checks ID on delivery.

items.q: Does PS VR2 work without a PS5?
items.a: No, the headset needs a PS5. Don't have one? Take ours — PS5 and PS VR2 together are 20% cheaper.

items.q: How much space do I need for VR?
items.a: About 2×2 metres of free space is enough for most games. Some games are played seated on the sofa.

items.q: Can I order a console and a hookah together?
items.a: Yes, we bring everything in one trip. And a PS5 with PS VR2 comes with 20% off.

items.q: The game I want isn't listed — what now?
items.a: Send us the title in DM. We'll check if it's on the account or on disc and let you know right away.
DM us on Instagram @ps.wawa: what you want, for how long and where to bring it. The website doesn't take orders — only Instagram DM.
